title: OpenAI Reports AI "Research Interns" and Warns Against Moving Too Fast
summary: OpenAI reports that AI agents in its own research already handle 3.1 workdays for every human workday, and it says it has reached its goal of an "automated research intern." But chief scientist Pachocki warns that no lab has a good enough grip on alignment and monitoring to keep scaling at maximum speed. The article OpenAI Reports AI "Research Interns" and Warns Against Moving Too Fast appeared first on The Decoder .
